name: ott-store-monorepo
description: StreamVault India OTT & Digital Subscription Store (Frontend + Backend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
